name: 20181 · Nokesville, VA
findings: ZIP 20181 (Nokesville) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20181 (Nokesville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20181 (Nokesville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
